summary: Design ownership, quality rules, golden records, and ERP synchronisation. Explore practical master data management training and enquire today.
lede: Master data management is the coordinated governance of shared business records across systems. For data stewards, ERP leads, and data managers, this course covers assigning ownership and defining quality rules, resolving duplicates and documenting golden-record decisions, and mapping cross-system synchronisation. Exercises use record samples, Excel-based checks, and data-flow maps to support quality monitoring and governed attribute definitions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who own, govern, integrate, or rely on shared business records across ERP and departmental systems.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working familiarity with at least one business data process, such as finance, procurement, HR, ERP, or analytics. No coding or programming is required. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted matching and integration architecture receive conceptual or operational coverage, not technical implementation training.
